question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 2(7)/(8) years at the rate of 2.9% per annum is 8,671. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 4.5% per annuun simple interest in 4(2)/(5) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest = 8671

Time = 2(7)/(8) years

Rate = 2.9% per annum

New rate = 4.5% per annum

New time = 4(2)/(5) years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time = **2(7)/(8)** = 23 ÷ 8 years

⇒ 8671 = (P × 2.9 × 23) ÷ (8 × 100)

⇒ 8671 = (P × 667) ÷ 8000

⇒ P = (8671 × 8000) ÷ 667

⇒ P = 104000

⇒ New time = 4(2)/(5) = 22 ÷ 5 years

⇒ New simple interest = (104000 × 4.5 × 22) ÷ (5 × 100)

⇒ New simple interest = 20592

⇒ Amount = 104000 + 20592

⇒ Amount = 124592

**∴ The correct answer is 124592.**
